course.title: PostgreSQL — From Beginner to Professional
course.description: A visual-first PostgreSQL course from server foundations and SQL through relational design, analytics, JSON/search, transactions, performance, secure access, operations, recovery, replication, application integration and specialist internals. All content remains draft until technical review and lab verification.
course.version_scope: Primary reference: PostgreSQL 18.6 documentation, checked 2026-10-15. The official documentation lists PostgreSQL 18.6 as the current supported 18.x manual and PostgreSQL 19 as a development/beta track; 19-only behavior is not assumed stable. Re-check current release notes and environment/provider differences before publication. PostgreSQL 18 makes virtual generated columns the default; EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement; optional extensions such as PostGIS/pg_trgm depend on installation/privileges.
prerequisites: Basic computer and command-line skills. Prior SQL or programming experience is helpful but not required. Install PostgreSQL 18.x or use an approved managed development database; live system administration exercises require an isolated environment and appropriately authorized role.
learning_outcomes: Design relational schemas with suitable data types, keys, constraints and normalized relationships.
Write and debug SQL including joins, subqueries, analytics, JSONB and full-text queries.
Use transactions, MVCC and locks to reason about integrity and concurrent application workflows.
Inspect query plans and choose indexes with measured workload evidence.
Secure, monitor, back up, restore and integrate PostgreSQL using version-aware professional practices.
